## Design note

The delivery van that is always double-parked. Heavy, tall and soft, it leans like a boat, brakes long and gets out of breath above 150 km/h — but at city speeds it is a two-and-a-half-tonne wall that wins most shoves.

## How this car breaks

Body-on-frame: full-length frame rails take frontal and rear hits, so bumpers and the short nose crumple while the frame stays straight. The cargo box behind the seat partition is thin sheet on light hoops — side and rear hits dent it deeply without touching the cab. The high, flat side is an easy target and the high CG tips it in hard swerves.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 2000s full-size cargo vans
- owner dyno averages for 4.8 L truck V8s
- engineering tables (truck tire radius, leaf/coil ride frequency, caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 1730 | 0.85 | 1470 |
| pitch | 7590 | 0.95 | 7210 |
| yaw | 7530 | 0.97 | 7300 |

## Drivetrain

4-speed automatic with lock-up torque converter, open rear differential. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Torque converter: stall 2000 rpm, 2.0× at stall, couples 1:1 from 2400 rpm (class-typical for the gearbox). Clutch capacity 1.60 × peak torque = 640 N·m. Shift time 0.35 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.06 | 10.47 | 75 |
| 2 | 1.63 | 5.57 | 141 |
| 3 | 1.00 | 3.42 | 229 |
| 4 | 0.70 | 2.39 | 328 |

Final drive 3.42, reverse 2.29. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.371 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.27 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 655 kg | 1.25 Hz | 40400 N/m | 2780 N·s/m | 4170 N·s/m | 0.20 m |
| Rear | 486 kg | 1.55 Hz | 46100 N/m | 2560 N·s/m | 3840 N·s/m | 0.22 m |

Round 12b ride rule (A): the file carries the derived dampers × 1.2 bump / × 1.6 rebound (rebound ≈ 2 × bump), after any tunes below: **3340 / 6670 N·s/m F, 3070 / 6140 N·s/m R** (bump / rebound).

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 5.5°/g with 70% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.682 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 173048 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 60443 F / 68172 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **20300 F / 0 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 5.0°/g, front share 64%. Bump stops 300000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.0° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 4.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 325 mm disc, pistons per side 57 mm + 57 mm → A = 51.0 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 138 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·51.0 cm²·0.138 m = **5614 N·m**
- Rear: 330 mm disc, pistons per side 54 mm → A = 22.9 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 140 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·22.9 cm²·0.140 m = **2565 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 3560 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.58×), rear needs 961 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.67×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 1515 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.629** → delivered 5610 N·m front / 1516 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 2980 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 18.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 13.4 m → outer-front path radius 6.58 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.75 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.626 rad (35.8°)** (outer 31.4°, inner 41.5° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.70). Rack speed 1.2 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/drayman_cargo.json`)

315 nodes, 2078 beams, 8 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-lattice --id drayman_cargo --profile suv --width 2.01 --length 5.69 --height 2.08 --wheelbase 3.43 --mass 545.9 --car-mass 2481.4 --clearance 0.2 --front-overhang 0.9 --strength 1.15` (22% of vehicle mass in the lattice; strength from durability class 4).
- Era `2000s` passenger cell: 178 cabin/sill, 165 cross-member, 10 pillar, 24 roof rail → hss × 0.90 section.
- Steel hood: 132 hood beams aluminum → mild_steel.
- Chrome steel bumpers: 184 bumper beams pp_bumper → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Body-on-frame: 18 cab-floor rail nodes relabelled FrameLeft/FrameRight; 16 under-cab rail beams → hss 3.08e-04 m² so the ladder frame runs bumper to bumper.
- Cargo box: 44 Cabin nodes behind the seat partition (y < -0.01 m, just behind the front doors) relabelled FrameRear — the passenger cell is the cab only, so cargo-box hits are body damage, not cabin intrusion.
